name: DANGO COD Order Form for WooCommerce
author: DANGO

sections.description:
More cash-on-delivery orders. Fewer fake ones.

Customers tap “Order now”, enter their name, phone, city and address, and the order is placed. No cart, no account, no card.

Prefer your normal checkout? Keep it, and still ask risky orders to pay the delivery charge in advance.

Every order is a normal WooCommerce order, so your stock, emails, coupons and reports keep working. The free plugin has no order limit, no trial and no licence key.

What you get

  • One-step ordering: a popup or a form on the product page, a sticky “Order now” bar on phones, quick-buy buttons on shop pages, a cart-page button, or the form in place of your checkout.
  • Fewer fake orders: invisible bot trap, duplicate-order check, daily limits per phone and connection, and a blocklist. No CAPTCHA puzzles for real customers.
  • Advance payment: ask every order, or only risky ones, to pay the delivery charge, part of the order or all of it online first. The rest is paid in cash.
  • Six form languages: English, Urdu, Roman Urdu, Arabic, French and Spanish, with right-to-left layout. Every word can be changed.
  • Built for COD markets: phone checks for 50+ countries, searchable city lists for Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt and Morocco, and delivery charges by city or from your WooCommerce shipping zones.
  • Your look: drag-and-drop form builder with live preview, three templates, your brand colour and dark mode.
  • Ad tracking: Meta, TikTok and Google Analytics 4 events, with campaign details saved on each order.
  • Fast: nothing loads on pages without a form.

Free and Pro

The free plugin is complete and works on its own. DANGO COD Order Form Pro is an optional paid add-on for stores that want more.

Free includes:

  • The order form on product, shop, cart and checkout pages, plus shortcode, block and Elementor widget
  • Form builder, three templates, six languages and custom fields
  • Coupons, tax, delivery charges and terms & conditions
  • Bot trap, duplicate check, daily limits, blocklist and rejected-orders log
  • Advance payment
  • Meta, TikTok and Google Analytics 4 browser events

Pro adds:

  • Bigger orders: quantity offers and bundles, order bumps, one-click upsells, “frequently bought together”, “buy 2, get 1 free”
  • Stronger protection: one-time codes by SMS or WhatsApp, and risk rules that block, ask for a code or ask for an advance
  • Order confirmation: confirm-or-cancel links, a call queue for your team, and an “edit my order” link for customers
  • Lost-sale recovery: see who started an order but did not finish, then call, message or remind them
  • More forms: different forms per product, multi-step forms, conditional fields, file uploads, 12 extra templates and A/B tests
  • Reports and connections: full reports, server-side ad events, Google Sheets and webhooks

See DANGO COD Order Form Pro

Works with

WPML, Polylang, currency switchers, Elementor, WooCommerce order storage (HPOS), block and classic themes, and full-page caching. Also connects with TrackKaro courier tracking, SafeShip and DANGO System Utilities if you use them.

External services

This plugin connects to outside services only when you switch them on. It never contacts DANGO or TrackKaro servers.

  • Cloudflare Turnstile, if enabled under Protection: the customer’s browser loads Cloudflare’s script from challenges.cloudflare.com, and your site sends the answer, your secret key and the customer’s IP address to Cloudflare to confirm the visitor is human. Terms, Privacy
  • Meta Pixel, if you enter a Pixel ID: the browser loads Meta’s script from connect.facebook.net and sends page-view, checkout and purchase events (order value, currency, product ids). Terms, Privacy
  • TikTok Pixel, if you enter a Pixel ID: the browser loads TikTok’s script from analytics.tiktok.com and sends page-view, checkout and payment events (order value, currency, products). Terms, Privacy
  • Google Analytics 4, if you enter a measurement ID: the browser loads Google’s tag from www.googletagmanager.com and sends page-view, checkout and purchase events (order number, value, currency, products). Terms, Privacy

Pixel code can be turned off when another plugin already loads it, and events can wait for cookie consent through the WordPress Consent API.

Source code

All PHP, JavaScript and CSS is human-readable and shipped as written. Nothing is compiled or minified, and no third-party libraries are included.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate this plugin.
  3. Follow the short setup: choose your country, language, where the form shows and how it looks.
  4. Open a product page and place a test order with test mode on.
sections.faq:
Does it replace my checkout?

Only if you want it to. By default your normal checkout keeps working.

Is there a limit on orders?

No. Orders are unlimited.

Do I need the Pro add-on?

No. This plugin works fully on its own. Pro only adds extra tools.

Can risky customers pay before delivery?

Yes, under Settings → Advance payment. You need at least one online payment method switched on in WooCommerce.

Can I change the words on the form?

Yes. Pick one of six languages in the builder, then edit any text.

Does it work outside Pakistan?

Yes. Phone checks cover 50+ countries, and customers can pick their country if you sell to several.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • New: a green tick when the phone number is valid.
  • New: a clear “Cash to pay at your door” line on advance-payment orders, on the thank-you screen and in emails.
  • Better line spacing for Urdu and Arabic forms.
  • Change: the terms box now starts unticked on new installs.

1.1.2

  • DANGO product names corrected on the admin screens.

1.1.1

  • The plugin name is now written DANGO COD Order Form.

1.1.0

  • New: terms & conditions at order placement, as a checkbox or a short line, recorded on the order.
  • Change: the delivery-time note is now an estimated delivery time, off by default.

1.0.2

  • Fix: the form now shows WooCommerce tax, and its total matches the order.
  • New: “Charge tax on delivery” setting for the simple delivery charge.
  • Fix: with prices shown including tax, a discount no longer takes tax off twice.

1.0.1

  • Security hardening: all output escaped when printed.

1.0.0

  • First release.
